import datetime import hashlib import hmac import html import http.cookies import http.server import json import secrets import sqlite3 import sys import urllib.parse from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple DB_FILE = ":memory:" SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = "session_token" SESSION_DURATION_SECONDS = 1800 # 30 minutes def init_db(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None: with conn: conn.execute( """ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, salt TEXT NOT NULL ); """ ) conn.execute( """ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); """ ) def hash_password(password: str, salt: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[str, str]: if not salt: salt = secrets.token_hex(16) pw_hash = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac( "sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt.encode("utf-8"), iterations=100_000, ).hex() return pw_hash, salt def verify_password(stored_hash: str, salt: str, password_attempt: str) -> bool: attempt_hash, _ = hash_password(password_attempt, salt) return hmac.compare_digest(stored_hash, attempt_hash) def hash_session_token(token: str) -> str: return hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() class SessionManager: def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection): self.conn = conn def create_session(self, user_id: int, duration_seconds: int = SESSION_DURATION_SECONDS) -> str: self.cleanup_expired_sessions() raw_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) session_hash = hash_session_token(raw_token) now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) expires_at = now + datetime.timedelta(seconds=duration_seconds) with self.conn: self.conn.execute( """ INSERT INTO sessions (session_hash, user_id, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) """, (session_hash, user_id, now.isoformat(), expires_at.isoformat()), ) return raw_token def validate_session(self, raw_token: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]: if not raw_token: return None session_hash = hash_session_token(raw_token) now_str = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat() cursor = self.conn.cursor() cursor.execute( """ SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.expires_at, u.username FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.session_hash = ? AND s.expires_at > ? """, (session_hash, now_str), ) row = cursor.fetchone() if not row: return None return { "session_id": row[0], "user_id": row[1], "expires_at": row[2], "username": row[3], } def terminate_session(self, raw_token: Optional[str]) -> bool: if not raw_token: return False session_hash = hash_session_token(raw_token) with self.conn: cursor = self.conn.execute( "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE session_hash = ?", (session_hash,) ) return cursor.rowcount > 0 def terminate_all_user_sessions(self, user_id: int) -> int: with self.conn: cursor = self.conn.execute( "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,) ) return cursor.rowcount def cleanup_expired_sessions(self) -> int: now_str = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat() with self.conn: cursor = self.conn.execute( "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at <= ?", (now_str,) ) return cursor.rowcount class SecureAppRequestHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler): conn: sqlite3.Connection = None # type: ignore session_manager: SessionManager = None # type: ignore def _parse_form_data(self) -> Dict[str, str]: content_length_header = self.headers.get("Content-Length") if not content_length_header: return {} try: length = int(content_length_header) raw_body = self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8") parsed = urllib.parse.parse_qs(raw_body, keep_blank_values=True) return {k: v[0] for k, v in parsed.items()} except Exception: return {} def _get_cookie_token(self) -> Optional[str]: cookie_header = self.headers.get("Cookie") if not cookie_header: return None cookies = http.cookies.SimpleCookie() try: cookies.load(cookie_header) if SESSION_COOKIE_NAME in cookies: return cookies[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME].value except Exception: return None return None def _build_session_cookie(self, token: str, max_age: int) -> str: cookie = http.cookies.SimpleCookie() cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME] = token cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["path"] = "/" cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["httponly"] = True cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["samesite"] = "Lax" cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["max-age"] = max_age # In a strict HTTPS deployment, uncomment: # cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["secure"] = True return cookie.output(header="").strip() def _build_clear_cookie(self) -> str: cookie = http.cookies.SimpleCookie() cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME] = "" cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["path"] = "/" cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["httponly"] = True cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["samesite"] = "Lax" cookie[SESSION_COOKIE_NAME]["max-age"] = 0 return cookie.output(header="").strip() def _render_page(self, title: str, body_html: str, status_code: int = 200, headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> None: full_html = f""" {html.escape(title)}

{html.escape(title)}

{body_html} """ data = full_html.encode("utf-8") self.send_response(status_code) self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data))) self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff") self.send_header("X-Frame-Options", "DENY") if headers: for k, v in headers.items(): self.send_header(k, v) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(data) def _redirect(self, location: str, headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> None: self.send_response(303) self.send_header("Location", location) self.send_header("Content-Length", "0") if headers: for k, v in headers.items(): self.send_header(k, v) self.end_headers() def do_GET(self) -> None: parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path) token = self._get_cookie_token() session = self.session_manager.validate_session(token) if parsed_url.path == "/" or parsed_url.path == "/dashboard": if session: body = f"""

Welcome, {html.escape(session['username'])}!

Session Expires: {html.escape(session['expires_at'])}

""" self._render_page("Dashboard", body) else: body = """

Sign In

Register

""" self._render_page("Sign In / Register", body) else: self._render_page("Not Found", "

Page not found.

", status_code=404) def do_POST(self) -> None: parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path) form_data = self._parse_form_data() if parsed_url.path == "/register": username = form_data.get("username", "").strip() password = form_data.get("password", "") if not username or not password: self._render_page("Registration Error", "

Username and password are required.

Back", status_code=400) return pw_hash, salt = hash_password(password) try: with self.conn: self.conn.execute( "INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, salt) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (username, pw_hash, salt), ) self._redirect("/") except sqlite3.IntegrityError: self._render_page("Registration Error", "

Username already taken.

Back", status_code=409) elif parsed_url.path == "/login": username = form_data.get("username", "").strip() password = form_data.get("password", "") cursor = self.conn.cursor() cursor.execute("SELECT id, password_hash, salt FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,)) user = cursor.fetchone() if user and verify_password(user[1], user[2], password): user_id = user[0] token = self.session_manager.create_session(user_id) cookie_str = self._build_session_cookie(token, SESSION_DURATION_SECONDS) self._redirect("/", headers={"Set-Cookie": cookie_str}) else: self
